subject: sci-dym
title: SCI.DYM.------PROJ.DY.
description: Diagram in MP(II)-8, second of two on book p490, paired with v2-p490-1. (C)SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) is crossed with PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics): the question is what scientific-dynamics produces when crossed with projectional-dynamics in the context of state-broadcast cultural politics where the broadcasting apparatus doesn't comprehend its own material. INFO-DY (information dynamics) and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) form the upper-right cluster with METH (methodology). AFL (affinity alignment) and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) feed from the left. PER-TR (perceived transformation) and MT-INFO (multi-information) form lower constituting nodes. AFI (affinity insight), CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis), and C-INFO (composite information) cluster in the lower-right. PART (participation) and PROJ-DY (the partner) form the central output structure. Structural argument: scientific-dynamics crossed with projectional-dynamics requires individual-tendencies and affinity-alignment as foundational upstreams. The diagram makes Braxton's structural claim that scientific projection (even state-broadcast scientific projection) only becomes culturally productive when grounded in individual tendencies and affinity alignment — without those, it remains uncomprehended apparatus.
